paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Nazir 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.38b.8), raising an objection to Rav Ashi; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rava of Parzakya, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage reads Ravina of Parzakya speaking to Rav Ashi. Hyman considers Ravina a copyist’s mistake and proposes Rava of Parzakya.
